![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQxMzAyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--428789535e7c3039c185f53aeb1dafff592214a3/BCC%202026%20for%20Canva.ai%20(1800%20x%201800%20px)%20(1).png)

## CubingBC and Speedcubing Canada welcome you to BC Quiet Championship 2026!

### IMPORTANT NOTE 1: This competition is only hosting 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Blindfolded, and 3x3x3 Multi-Blind.

For regular speedsolving events, please see
[BC Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026), or [other competitions in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=CA).

### IMPORTANT NOTE 2: If you are registered for the main BC Championship 2026, registration for this competition is FREE. In this case, please indicate in your registration comments that you are registered for both, and DO NOT pay the $20.00 registration fee. 

**Everybody is welcome to compete at the second-ever BC Championship!** Competitors from any country or region are invited to register, whether you’re a seasoned competitor or this is your very first competition. 

The highest placing British Columbia resident in each event will be recognized as the **2026 BC Champion**. Check out the [BC Champion Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCQuietChampionship2026#70680-bc-champion-eligibility) tab for more information.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association (WCA) competition. All competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations prior to competing. If this is your first competition, please refer to the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCQuietChampionship2026#70679-faq-resources) tab for helpful tips.

---

To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz).
You are also welcome to join the Facebook group
[Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494).

Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**.

You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon. **Please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQxMjY0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3ac052458bf99a2d6ce589b161550c7321f8e669/CubingBC%20and%20SpeedcubingCanadaLogo.png)

**Notice of filming and photography:**
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

**Health and Safety:**
Masks will be optional at this event. Please stay home if you are sick or feeling unwell.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk1NzE4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d2b53712ac871ab6dd62d8e0a7492a029417cfaa/logo-cec-1.jpg)

**🇧🇷 Português:**
A competição é aberta a participantes de todas as idades. As inscrições devem ser realizadas exclusivamente pelo site da WCA, mediante pagamento antecipado da taxa via PIX. A inscrição será confirmada apenas após a validação do pagamento.

Para garantir o bom andamento do evento, ao se inscrever em uma modalidade você também assume o compromisso de atuar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria, conforme estabelecido pelas regras da WCA. Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, com as responsabilidades divididas entre todos os competidores. Em cada modalidade haverá, no mínimo, dois grupos: em um deles você competirá e, no outro, ajudará como juiz ou embaralhador.

Ao efetuar sua inscrição, você autoriza a AACM, a WCA e seus parceiros a utilizarem gratuitamente sua imagem em fotos e filmagens realizadas durante o evento, inclusive para fins comerciais.

---

**🇺🇸 English:**
The competition is open to participants of all ages. Registrations must be made exclusively through the WCA website, with the entry fee paid in advance via PIX. Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation.

To ensure the smooth running of the event, by registering for an event you also commit to serving as a judge or scrambler in that category, as established by the WCA regulations. In this way, the competition becomes self-sustainable, with responsibilities shared among all competitors. For each event, there will be at least two groups: in one you will compete, and in the other you will serve as a judge or scrambler.

By completing your registration, you authorize AACM, WCA, and their partners to freely use your image in photos and videos taken during the event, including for commercial purposes.

items.information:
## VOLUNTEERING
Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind.

## SPONSORSHIP

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5MTA0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8009ba06c22285cc1d3d3488d30eaedc709350c8/IMG_6226.png)

A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.
You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. follow them on socials by scanning the QR Code below.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjcwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bea620be86f2f2e79b7ff56af3eef8d900240518/IMG_2596.jpg)

The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** have gracouisly offered us the venue at a very reduced rate as part of their support for the competition. Please continue to return the favour to them by supporting their restaurant and accomodation. Also follow the hotel on socials by scanning the QR code below.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjY1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--781305c69b42fd5cad23e5a76d3b2c4c6e2cd2f3/IMG_2595.jpg)

##Accommodation 

The hotel have offered discounted accommodation rates to our cubers (and guests) for the weekend of the competition. You can book your accomodation by sending an email to Penny Mbobo pmbobo@legacyhotels.co.za and mention the code "Rubiks 2026" when making your booking. Reach out to the competition organizers or delegates if you have more questions.



## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS
Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time.

## About CubingZA
CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.
If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

**Español**
**Esta es la competencia oficial de FMC, 4x4-Blind y Multi-Blind del Campeonato Nacional de SpeedCubing.**

Las categorías disputadas en este evento no estarán en los días de competencia del campeonato Panama Nationals 2026, por lo que esta es tu oportunidad de convertirte en el campeón nacional de estas categorías.

Todos los espectadores pueden asistir de forma gratuita, los resultados preliminares, y los clasificados a rondas posteriores, se podrán ver casi en tiempo real en WCA Live.

**English**
**This is the official FMC, 4x4-Blind, and Multi-Blind competition of the National Championship.**

The categories contested in this event will not be included in the main championship "Panama Nationals 2026", so this is your chance to become the national champion in these categories.

All spectators can attend for free. Preliminary results and those advancing to later rounds can be viewed in near real-time on WCA Live.

Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and pay for your ticket to confirm your entry. Please see Registration Requirements below for instructions and when registration opens.

We will be having an odd mix of main, side and blind events in this One Day, One Stop, All-Out Total Non-Stop Action-Based Competition so be sure to stick around for all sorts of weird and unique tastes of skill, fortitude and perseverance!! 




**All New Competitors**
If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct.
Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee.

# There is a [Spectator Limit](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentKoreaOpen2026#75885-spectator-limit).

If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentKoreaOpen2026#75887-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentKoreaOpen2026#75886-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering.

All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request.

Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

items.name: Silesian Minx Fest 2026

venue.name: Wojewódzka Biblioteka Publiczna im. E. Smołki w Opolu

items.information:
![](https://i.imgur.com/y4aZ08M.png) **Polski:**
Zapraszamy na czwartą edycję Silesian Minx Fest - wyjątkowych zawodów z minxami na wolnym powietrzu!
Wydarzenie jest organizowane dzięki wsparciu Wojewódzkiej Biblioteki Publicznej im. Emanuela Smołki w Opolu!
Zapoznaj się ze wszystkimi zakładkami przed rejestracją. 
Zwróć szczególną uwagę, że konkurencje poniedziałkowe i wtorkowe, czyli 3x3x3 wiele kostek bez patrzenia, 3x3x3 najmniejsza liczba ruchów oraz 4x4x4 bez patrzenia i 5x5x5 bez patrzenia odbędą się w innym obiekcie oddalonym od głównej sali (namiotu) o około 500m. Adres to ul. Krakowska 39, 45-075 Opole.
 
---------
![](https://i.imgur.com/i1ldA95.png) **English:**
We invite you to the fourth edition of Silesian Minx Fest - the unusual outdoor competition with minxes as the main theme! 
The competition is organized thanks to the support of the Voivodeship Public Library in Opole!
Please check information in all tabs before registrating.
Please note that Monday's and Tuesday's events: FMC, 4BLD, 5BLD and MBLD will take place in another venue about 500 m away from the main venue. The address: Krakowska 39, 45-075 Opole.
